title: HEALTH DISPARITIES THROUGH GENERATIVE AI MODELS: A COMPARISON STUDY USING A DOMAIN SPECIFIC LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic similarity using cosine similarity of text embeddings to determine if models disproportionately associate queries mentioning race as a unique factor with negative statements about perpetuating health disparities.

Testing semantic similarity of embeddings for queries regarding low-income communities and food deserts against statements about health disparities to establish baselines for understanding marginalized groups.
